propositions: PR #128 proposes four dependency bumps; three (json-repair 0.63.0, genai-prices 0.1.2, botocore 1.43.69) are safe and within existing constraints, but mcp 2.0 migration is deferred to epic 732b
The safe subset must land via Gerrit with no pyproject.toml edits, lock-only changes to uv.lock, verified by lint/typecheck and targeted usage-surface tests
Dependabot.yml must be updated to ignore mcp semver-major updates (patch/minor still flow) to prevent recurring rejected re-proposals until mcp 2.0 migration completes
If any of the three safe bumps fails tests or gates, only that package is dropped and the remaining safe packages land; all successes or partial subset both satisfy done-state AC2b
The merged change must record json-repair 0.63.0, genai-prices 0.1.2, botocore 1.43.69 in uv.lock with mcp remaining at 1.29.0, and include the dependabot.yml ignore rule with 732b rationale
